title: Containment, Study & Isolation
description: To study an anomaly you must keep it alive; to keep the world safe you must keep it from spreading. Quarantine is the art of clearing it just faster than it copies itself; R below 1, and not much below. Unlocks the Quarantine Field Matrix.

puzzle.goal: A contained anomalous unit makes new ones at a constant rate β while it is active, and stops being active either by clearing itself (rate γ) or by being caught by the quarantine field (rate q), so it is still active a time τ after it appeared with probability exp(−(γ + q)τ). Write the expected number of new units it makes in its whole active life.
puzzle.name: effective reproduction number under quarantine (renewal integral)
puzzle.form: int ( 0 , ∞ , β * exp ( - ( γ + q ) * τ ) , τ )
puzzle.ask: The integral is β/(γ + q). Find the smallest quarantine rate q that holds R_e at 1 (containment) for the β and γ given, in units per day.
puzzle.method: Integrate the rate of making new units times the probability of still being active at each age.
